## For each loops

c#

```cs
foreach (type variableName in arrayName) 
{
  // code block to be executed
}
```

java


```java
for (type variableName : arrayName) {
  // code block to be executed
}
```


### Javascript 

for...of (closest equivalent)

```js
const numbers = [1, 2, 3];

for (const n of numbers) {
    console.log(n);
}
```



for...in for keys (not values) — common source of bugs

```js
const arr = ["a", "b", "c"];

for (const i in arr) {
    console.log(i);   // "0", "1", "2"  (indexes!)
}

for (const v of arr) {
    console.log(v);   // "a", "b", "c"  (values)
}


```
